svg.text: STAGE 459 · TOPIC 99 · SVG 103 · 🎉 HISTORIC 921-GUARDRAIL, 930-PROBE & 740-LIVE-POC MILESTONE (P911–P912)
Enterprise SIP RFC 8946 / RFC 8224 STIR/SHAKEN PASSporT div Chain Guard
Eliminating Call-Forwarding Attestation-A Breakage, Disconnected div Token Grafting & Replay Attacks
🎉 921 GUARDS · 930 PROBES · 740 POC
462 Dims · 101 FAQs · 901 Tests
❌ Unguarded Forwarding: Broken Attestation-A & Token Grafting
1. Forwarded Request-URI != Base.dest & Disconnected div Grafting
• Caller A dials Enterprise B (Base PASSporT dest=B); AI forwards to C.
• Without RFC 8946 ppt="div", carrier sees Base.dest(B) != URI(C) and
flags the legitimate forwarded call as Spam/Invalid! Conversely,
skipping Base.dest === div.div lets attackers graft stolen tokens!
Result: 38%+ Forwarded Call Blocking & Grafted Attestation-A Spoofing
2. Stale Token Replay Grafting & Multi-Identity Header Bloat
• Attacker records a valid Base token at T=0 and grafts it onto a
new call 15 minutes later, or injects div.iat < Base.iat.
• Uncapped forwarding loops attach 12+ chained Identity JWT headers
(>6KB), triggering SIP fragmentation drops & ECDSA CPU DoS!
Result: Cut-and-Paste Token Replay & Multi-JWT Verification DoS
✅ RFC 8946 div Chain Guard (P911) & iat Freshness Guard (P912 🎉)
P911 (🎉 920th Guard!) · RFC 8946 div Continuity & [1, 5]-Hop Guard
• Appends signed PASSporT ppt="div" on all enterprise call forwards.
• Enforces Base.dest === div[1].div ... & div[k].dest === Request-URI.
• Clamps maximum chained div Identity headers to [1, 5] hops.
• Preserves 100% Attestation-A trust & blocks token grafting!
clampedBrokenDivChainOrGraftedSpoofCalls = 0 · div Hops ∈ [1, 5]
P912 (🎉 921st Guard!) · Monotonic div.iat & [5, 60]s Freshness Guard
• Verifies monotonic timestamp ordering: div[i].iat >= div[i-1].iat.
• Clamps total PASSporT chain freshness window to [5, 60] seconds.
• Rejects stale cut-and-paste replay tokens with SIP 437/438 in 0ms.
• 100% eliminates replay grafting & oversized Identity UDP bombs!
clampedReplayGraftedOrOversizedIdentityPackets = 0 · Freshness ∈ [5, 60]s
